findings.title: Companionship as protected entrustment
findings.claim: The people named as أصحاب الميمنة can also be perceived as a durable relation of entrusted protection: trust, guarding, and standing responsible make their companionship operational.
findings.mechanism: The focus occurrence 90:18:2:1 carries protective accompaniment. It meets 90:17:5, where belief supplies settled trust, 90:13:2, where the neck supplies guarding and custody, and 90:17:7, where patience supplies continuing presence. The separate carriers and the focus noun therefore change companionship from a bare class label into a relation in which care is held, guarded, and sustained.
findings.reader_payoff: The class title becomes socially concrete: belonging is visible as reliable care that remains with what has been entrusted.
findings.containment: The plain reading remains the classification of this group as the people of the right side. The finding uses the supplied security, guarding, and surety images only for the protected-belonging resonance and does not claim that every use of the cited context words activates these branches.
